name: Build and Publish MCPRemoteProxy Configuration Validation

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
    paths:
      - 'cmd/thv-operator/**'
      - 'internal/**'
      - '.github/workflows/skills-build-and-publish.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
    paths:
      - 'cmd/thv-operator/**'
      - 'internal/**'
      - '.github/workflows/skills-build-and-publish.yml'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v4
      with:
        go-version: '1.21'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        go mod tidy
        go get -u github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/cmd/golangci-lint

    - name: Run golangci-lint
      run: |
        golangci-lint run ./cmd/thv-operator/... ./internal/...

    - name: Build operator
      run: |
        go build -o thv-operator ./cmd/thv-operator/

    - name: Run unit tests
      run: |
        go test -v ./internal/... -run "TestValidate.*"

    - name: Run integration tests
      run: |
        go test -v ./internal/... -run "TestIntegration.*"

    - name: Verify build
      run: |
        go build ./cmd/thv-operator/...
        ls -la thv-operator

  publish:
    needs: build
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Docker Buildx
      uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

    - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
      uses: docker/login-action@v2
      with:
        registry: ghcr.io
        username: ${{ github.actor }}
        password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    - name: Extract metadata
      id: meta
      uses: docker/metadata-action@v4
      with:
        images: ghcr.io/stacklok/toolhive/thv-operator
        tags: |
          type=sha,prefix={{branch}}-
          type=raw,value=latest,enable=${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}

    - name: Build and push
      uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
      with:
        context: .
        file: ./Dockerfile
        push: true
        tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
        labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
